programme.title: Ipswich vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/25 Week 1
programme.desc: Ipswich Town’s most recent Premier League game was in May 2002 against Liverpool at Anfield, losing 5-0 as they were relegated. Liverpool have never lost a Premier League match at Portman Road against Ipswich Town, with their last visit a 6-0 win in February 2002. They’ve played more games there without losing than any other ground in the Premier League.

programme.desc: Real Madrid have not lost any of their last 11 matches against Sevilla in LaLiga, their second-best unbeaten run against the Sevillian side in the history of the competition, after a 15-match unbeaten run between 1993 and 2003. Sevilla have lost 14 and drawn just once in their last 15 visits to Real Madrid in LaLiga and can equal the worst winless run away against them in their history in the competition, suffered between 1986 and 2004.

programme.title: Leganés vs Villarreal - LaLiga 2024/25 Week 18
programme.desc: Leganés have won just two of their eight games against Villarreal in LaLiga, 3-1 at Butarque in December 2017 and 2-1 at La Cerámica in March 2020 in their last meeting in the competition. Villarreal have won their last two visits to Butarque in all competitions, managing just one win fewer than in their other 11 away games against Leganés.

programme.title: Mallorca vs Barcelona - LaLiga 2024/25 Week 19
programme.desc: Mallorca have lost 14 and drawn just two of their last 16 meetings vs FC Barcelona in LaLiga, the worst winless run against the same opponent in their entire history in the top-flight. Their last league win against FC Barcelona was in May 2009 on the antepenultimate matchday. FC Barcelona have won 81% of their away games against Mallorca in the 21st Century, their highest percentage of away wins against the same opponent in the competition in at least 10 meetings since then.

programme.title: Athletic Bilbao vs Real Madrid - LaLiga 2024/25 Week 19
programme.desc: Athletic Club have not won any of their last 18 matches against Real Madrid in LaLiga, since a 1-0 win in March 2015 with current coaches Ernesto Valverde and Carlo Ancelotti on the respective benches, their worst winless run against the same opponent in the competition ever. Real Madrid have collected points in their last nine visits to Athletic Club in LaLiga, winning the last five. No team in the history of the competition has ever won six straight away victories against the Basque side.

programme.title: Espanyol vs Leganés - LaLiga 2024/25 Week 19
programme.desc: This will be the ninth meeting between Espanyol and Leganés in LaLiga, with each side having won both meetings in the season each time: Espanyol in 16/17 and 18/19 and Leganés in 17/18 and 19/20. CD Leganés have won three of their last five away games against Espanyol in all competitions, having lost in the three previous meetings. All three wins at Espanyol's home ground have been by the same scoreline: 1-0.

programme.title: Deportivo Alavés vs Girona - LaLiga 2024/25 Week 19
programme.desc: Alavés have won two, drawn two and lost two of their six matches against Girona in LaLiga, repeating the same pattern: win - loss - draw. In their last meeting, the two sides played out a 2-2 draw in Vitoria last May. After winning six of their first seven home games against Girona in all competitions, Alavés have won just two of their next seven at home against the Catalans.

Osasuna won 4-1 on their last visit to Atlético de Madrid in LaLiga and have only twice in their history collected points in two consecutive away games against the red-and-whites in the competition.

programme.title: Sevilla vs Valencia - LaLiga 2024/25 Week 19

programme.title: Toulouse vs PSG - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 22
programme.desc: Paris have won 24 of their last 29 games in all competitions against Toulouse, only winning more often against Marseille and Lyon in all competitions since the start of 2010. programme.title: Le Havre vs Nice - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 22

programme.title: Lille vs Monaco - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 23
programme.desc: Mika Biereth has scored seven goals in his first five Ligue 1 games; an all-time record for a Monaco player, and the joint-highest tally at this stage in the 21st century for any team, alongside Zlatan Ibrahimovic. programme.title: Auxerre vs Olympique Marseille - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 23

No player has scored more goals following a fast break than Gaëtan Perrin in Ligue 1 this season: three, level with Bradley Barcola. The Auxerre player has seven goals in 22 L1 games this season and could record his outright-most in a L1 or Ligue 2 campaign.

programme.title: Olympique Lyonnais vs PSG - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 23

programme.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Manchester United have won just one of their last 12 Premier League meetings with Liverpool, beating them 2-1 at Old Trafford in their third game of the 2022-23 campaign. Liverpool have lost just one of their last six Premier League away games against Manchester United, while only Manchester City have won away at Old Trafford more often than the Reds in the competition’s history.

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Everton won 2-0 in their last Premier League game against Liverpool in April 2024, last winning consecutive league Merseyside derbies in the 1984-85 campaign. Liverpool’s 2-0 loss in this exact fixture last season ended a 12-game unbeaten away run in the Premier League against Everton. They’ve not lost consecutive visits to Goodison Park since a run of three between 1992 and 1994.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Crystal Palace- English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Man City have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, going down 2-0 at home in October 2021. Having lost each of their first six Premier League visits to the Etihad Stadium, Crystal Palace have lost just two of their last six away to Man City in the competition.

programme.title: Final. Anna Bondar / Loïs Boisson
programme.desc: Loïs Boisson confirms that it is not just a temporary flooding of spring. Tricolor revelation in Roland-Garros, the 22-year-old Dijonnaise qualified for her first final on the main circuit at the WTA 250 in Hamburg. Invited via a Wild-Card, the 63rd world dominated the Ukrainian Dayana Yastremska (6-1, 7-6) in the semi-finals, despite a fear at the end of the match when she was leading 6-1, 5-3. A victory for the mind that propels her to a first career title match. Opposite, she finds Hungarian Anna Bondar (77th), falling from the seeded n ° 1 in quarter and who overthrew Slovenian Kaja Juvan into three sets (5-7, 6-3, 6-4) to rally her first final on the circuit at 28 years old. In play: a first coronation and an entry into the world top 50 for the Frenchwoman. A dream springboard, six weeks after its Parisian epic.

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.

programme.title: Tennis : Wimbledon
programme.desc: A month after their epic final in Roland-Garros, Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz are doing this: the two masters of the ATP circuit meet in the Wimbledon final to write a new page of their rivalry. Winner in Paris after a crazy comeback, Alcaraz aims for a historic hat -trick in London (2023, 2024, 2025). Faced with him, Sinner dreams of a first coronation on lawn, which would allow him to conquer a third different major, at only 23 years old. It will be their 13th duel. The Spaniard leads 8-4, remains on five consecutive victories and has not been beaten by the Italian since October 2023. But their only confrontation on grass, already in Wimbledon, had turned to the advantage of Sinner in 2022. Alcaraz aims for continuity, sinner. Between two wonders already in legend, the final promises a summit up to their meteoric ascent.

programme.title: Finale
programme.desc: The WTA tournament of IASI in Romania is played on clay and outdoors. The event has been in the WTA 125 category since 2022 and takes place in summer.

programme.title: Final. Anna Bondar / Loïs Boisson
programme.desc: Loïs Boisson confirms that it is not just a temporary flooding of spring. Tricolor revelation in Roland-Garros, the 22-year-old Dijonnaise qualified for her first final on the main circuit at the WTA 250 in Hamburg. Invited via a Wild-Card, the 63rd world dominated the Ukrainian Dayana Yastremska (6-1, 7-6) in the semi-finals, despite a fear at the end of the match when she was leading 6-1, 5-3. A victory for the mind that propels her to a first career title match. Opposite, she finds Hungarian Anna Bondar (77th), falling from the seeded n ° 1 in quarter and who overthrew Slovenian Kaja Juvan into three sets (5-7, 6-3, 6-4) to rally her first final on the circuit at 28 years old. In play: a first coronation and an entry into the world top 50 for the Frenchwoman. A dream springboard, six weeks after its Parisian epic.

Sixteen franchises make up this championship.

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.

programme.title: Tours / Poitiers
programme.desc: Last act, last breath: the TVB is about to live an evening with a history on Saturday in Grenon, against Poitiers. Winner at the first leg (3-1), Tours has a golden opportunity to win a 10th title of champion of France, which would propel him at the height of AS Cannes at the top of the hexagonal volleyball. But a derby does not obey any logic. Poitiers, heckled but far from being killed, knows that it would be a victory, four daring sets, to write his own legend. The feat of Nantes last year, who came to impose themselves in the gold set, feeds their hopes. The Alterna will count on Nik Mujanovic, in search of a last shine under the pepper colors before joining the TVB this summer. At the end of the road: Europe and the Champions League. But for Tours, it is also the culmination of a forged season in the fight. From Luca Ramon to Ryan Sclater, all want to write the perfect epilogue under the leadership of Marcelo Fronckowiak and engrave their name in the marble of Grenon.

A poster to say the least indecisive between two of the favorites for the final victory in the competition, whose winner will be opposed to that of Lyon / Bucharest in the quarterfinals.

programme.title: Eintracht Francfort / Ajax Amsterdam
programme.desc: Who will succeed the Atalanta Bergame at the top of the Europa League? Thirty-six European clubs are engaged in the race for the victory of this 2024/2025 edition of the continental competition

programme.title: Athletic Bilbao / AS Roma
programme.desc: Beaten by AS Rome in the first leg (2-1), Athletic Bilbao overturned AS Rome (3-1) in San Mamés, thanks in particular to the exclusion of Mats Hummels after only twelve minutes of play. With a double of Nico Williams, Bilbao qualified for the quarter-finals of the Europa League. The Basques dominated their subject, despite a little fear at the end of the match.

programme.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Righting quarantine
programme.desc: On February 5, 2025, Cristiano Ronaldo, one of the most legendary football players in history, celebrated his 40th birthday. The opportunity to come back to the extraordinary course of CR7, spotted by Manchester United and has become for five times Ballon d'Or, five times winner of the 2016 Champions and European Champions with Portugal.

programme.desc: A collection centered on tactical decryption in football. Immersive pallets and analyzes, Gauthier Kuntzmann delivers the keys to the methods used by coaches.

programme.title: Lyon / Paris FC
programme.desc: Paris FC remains on an astonishing defeat in Montpellier (2-0) and sees its chances of hanging second place in the ranking, behind Lyon. These are the Lyonnaises, inaccessible leaders of the Arkema Première League and undefeated since the start of the championship, who welcome the Parisians, at Park OL, to close this 20th day.

programme.title: Paris FC / Fleury
programme.desc: For this penultimate day of Arkema Première Ligue, the Paris FC of Gaëtane Thiney, which should end the season in third place, welcomes, at Stade Charléty, a Fleury team which fights for 5th place, with Montpellier. On the outward journey, Dominika Grabowska and the Fleury Lionesses had beaten their Parisian counterparts (2-1). The PFC will do everything to take revenge.

programme.title: Strasbourg / Reims
programme.desc: They were 7,483 supporters at the Meinau stadium to support RC Strasbourg who hoped to stay in the first league against Reims. The Strasbourgers were obliged to win to obtain their maintenance. It was a crazy match since it was in time added, that Strasbourg won, thanks to Liana Joseph, while the Alsatians have evolved ten since the 55th minute.

programme.title: End of programs
programme.desc: Our programs end for this day, while waiting for those of tomorrow.

programme.title: Free tests 1
programme.desc: Broadcasting the Belgian Grand Prix, one of the rounds of the Formula 1 World Championship. It is disputed on the legendary Spa-Francorchamps circuit, since 1950, where virtuosos such as the Fangio, Senna or Schumacher have shone, circuit considered one of the most beautiful in the championship. 7 km long, its 44 rpm will take us at the end of an afternoon of a spectacular race with its frequent games.

programme.title: Qualifying tests
